senses.gloss: (b. h.; cmp. בלי , v. Ges. H. Dict. s. v.) not, frequ. used, in connection with a verb, in the sense of a prohibitive law.
units: <cite ref="Eruvin 100a:18">Erub. 100ᵃ</cite> <he>עובר על בל תגרע</he> he transgresses the law which says ‘thou shalt not diminish therefrom’ (<cite ref="Deuteronomy 13:1">Deut. XIII, 1</cite>).

<cite ref="Mishnah Pesachim 3:3">Pes. III, 3</cite> <he>שמוזהרים עליו בבל יראה וכ׳</he> concerning which we are cautioned by the law prohibiting leavened things to be seen or to be found (<cite ref="Exodus 13:7">Ex. XIII, 7</cite>; <cite ref="Exodus 12:19">XII, 19</cite>); a. v. fr. [Our w. is also applied to Bible texts in which <cite ref="L00003"><he>לֹא</he></cite> appears.]
